purpose: Teach: 解い/こぼれ/海老/くれぐれも/元旦/眠気/病人/想い出

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、難しいクイズ、自分で、解いたんだよ、本当に、嬉しいんだ、自信、ついたよ。
lines.en: Mom — I solved a really hard puzzle all by myself. I'm so happy. I feel so confident now.
lines.style: Bright, proud opening with a small lift on the first syllable. Quick pace, eager to share. Breathless slightly at the middle — the excitement bubbling up. Genuine, un-performed.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。お味噌汁、こぼれちゃったわよ、翔くん、気をつけてね、テーブル、拭こうね、ママと一緒に。
lines.en: Oh, honey. The miso soup spilled. Be careful, Sho. Let's wipe the table down together, okay?
lines.style: Warm redirect. Gentle but attentive — noticing the spill without making it a problem. Soft on the instruction, inviting him into the task like it's a small shared moment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 夕食の海老、お父さん、本当に、好きなのよね、ママ、たくさん、お皿に、入れてあげようね。
lines.en: Dad really loves shrimp for dinner, doesn't he? Mom, let's put a lot on his plate.
lines.style: Eager, thoughtful child-voice. Quick bright tone — wanting to help. Small pause before 'Mom' like he's checking if his idea is okay. Genuine care mixed with the simple joy of doing something nice.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃんち、くれぐれも、失礼のないように、振る舞ってね、翔くん、お祖父ちゃん、楽しみにしてるから。
lines.en: When we go to Grandpa's house, make sure you behave yourself, Sho. He's really looking forward to seeing you.
lines.style: Practical and warm, but with quiet weight underneath. Steady pace. Not stern — more like she's preparing him for something that matters. Slight emphasis on 'looking forward,' the real kindness in it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 元旦、お父さん、休みなんでしょ、ママ、家族で、神社に、初詣、行きたいよ、絶対、お願い。
lines.en: Dad has New Year's Day off, doesn't he? Mom, can we all go to the shrine together for our first visit of the year? I really, really want to.
lines.style: Animated, hopeful pitch rising slightly at 'off'. Quick eager rhythm. The 'really, really' carries weight — this matters to him. Slight breathiness like he's asking something important, not just a casual request.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 眠気、ちょっと、出てきたのね、翔くん、お昼寝、しなさい、ママ、布団、用意するわよ、ゆっくり、休んでね。
lines.en: You're getting a little sleepy, aren't you? It's nap time, Sho. Mom will get your futon ready. Take your time and rest.
lines.style: Tender, observant. Slow, gentle cadence. Soft consonants. No rush in her voice — like she's giving him permission to rest. Slight warm fade at the end, like tucking him in with her words.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 病人さんに、お見舞い、行きたいよ、ママ、お祖母ちゃんの、お友達、入院されてるんでしょ、心配だよ、ぼく。
lines.en: I want to go visit someone in the hospital, Mom. Grandma's friend is there, isn't she? I'm worried about her.
lines.style: Quiet serious undertone. Thoughtful pacing — this isn't excitement, it's concern. Small hesitation before naming the illness, like he's working through the weight of it. Sincere, genuinely worried.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 家族の想い出、本当に、宝物よね、翔くん、写真、たくさん、残しておきたいわね、ママ、覚えておきたいの、いつも。
lines.en: Family memories are really treasures, aren't they, Sho? I want to keep so many photos. I want to remember everything, always.
lines.style: Soft, reflective tone. Slower pace, like she's speaking to herself as much as to him. Warm and a little wistful. Slight emphasis on 'always' — quiet determination to hold onto these moments.
